title: ECHOES OF LAST!!!
author: Monalisa Parida
text:
I do not wish for success,
Nor for gold,
Not even for health,
Or a future untold.
I wish for him—
I wish for the time.

He signed my birth certificate;
I signed his death certificate.

He picked my first outfit;
I chose his last.

He witnessed my first breath;
I witnessed his last.

He took me on my first ride;
I stood with him in his last rite.

He heard my very first words;
I listened to his very last words.

He must have seen my first tear,
But I surely saw his last tear.

And I still wonder:
Am I lucky or unlucky
To be with him
In his every last thing?

He is my father.
I am a doctor.
Yes, he left—
Something to gain.
